title: Grateful Dead Live at Radio City Music Hall on 1980-10-30
source: Loge Dead front center; Nak 700 > sony D-5> AMC> DAT> CDR> EAC> TLH> Flac; Recorded by Keith Gatto & Pete Jaeger; Extracted & flac encoded by Michael Turi; Patched and Edited in Sound Forge Pro. 10.0; Tracked in Audacity 2.0 by dusborne 06-06-2012

ai_review.summary: Decent front‑logement audience recording captures the show with acceptable clarity
ai_review.review: The reviewer was sitting just left of the soundboard in the front loge and recorded the concert (despite getting busted). The tape streams well enough for background listening, indicating a reasonably clear audience capture, though no musical details are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderately positive review (4 stars) with limited detail; recording seems usable but show performance is not described, leading to a cautious rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded from front loge near the soundboard; likely clear enough for streaming with typical audience ambience.
